sentences.text:
This appeal coming on for orders this day, the court passed the following:-
 ORDER

This miscellaneous appeal has been filed under Section 173 (1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, which is arising out of award dated 30.09.2019 passed by Second Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT), Barwani (MP) in Claim Case No.396 of 2018 on account of seeking enhancement of compensation.
(2) The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability is not in dispute, however the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard is not in question.

Ramu vs Hukum Mahapal on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150040594/
1 (3)

As per the findings of the Tribunal in the case of permanent disability of claimant Ramu, the amount of compensation has been awarded by the Tribunal in favour of claimant is Rs.3,78,500/-
with interest from the date of filing of claim application till its realization.
(4) Counsel for the appellant submits that Tribunal has committed grave error in the matter of awarding the amount of compensation and the compensation is on lower side.

He submitted that the deceased was engaged in the work at the time of accident but future prospects and compensation in other heads were not awarded and the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is on lower side.
So prays for enhancement of compensation which is just and proper compensation.

(5) Per contra, counsel for the respondent/Insurance Company submits that the amount of compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper and that there is no need of further enhancement and prays for rejection of the appeal.

(6) After hearing counsel for the parties and on perusal of the record and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and more particularly the age, nature of injuries and looking to the permanent disability of deceased, his earning and future prospects, it shall be appropriate to enhance the amount of Rs.70,000/-which shall carry interest @ 7% per annum from the date of filing of claim application till its realization and the finding in respect of liability awarded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
(7) In the result, the appeal is partly allowed and is disposed of, in above terms.
 (8) Certified copy, as per Rules.
